method: Frozen additional-history baseline/trend/trend-session, full TP1, independently verified RSI/SMA/ATR and causal M1 replay.
timestamp_assumption: UTC explicitly requested from historical provider; not a broker wall-clock inference

input_provenance.price_side: Provider OHLC; broker bid/ask is not independently established. Bid-side convention is an execution proxy.
input_provenance.closed_session_note: Unfiltered raw source includes indicative closed-session records; the validator must remove those before M1 execution and M5 aggregation.

bid_ohlc_interpretation: Provider OHLC; broker bid/ask is not independently established. Bid-side convention is an execution proxy.

canonical_php_plan_reference.method: Actual PHP-rounded legacy plans and actual V2 eligibility, independently checked against frozen JS entry discovery and raw indicators.
canonical_php_plan_reference.note: Numerical compatibility correction only. No entry rules, filters, dates, targets, costs or source prices changed.

coverage.note: Expected regular NY sessions are a template, not a verified historical holiday/broker calendar. Missing intervals can be scheduled closures or missing data.
coverage.holiday_status: No source-specific historical holiday or early-close status is verified. Regular NY filtering cannot prove that every retained indicative quote was executable.

costing.ordinary: Explicit assumed constant $0.37/oz spread added to provider OHLC; not a historical spread measurement.
costing.doubled: Double the supplied/assumed spread and slippage/fee assumptions. For native ASK data, bid + 2*(ask-bid) is only a field-wise stress proxy; independent extrema do not reconstruct true doubled-spread ticks.
costing.gross: Zero spread/slippage/fees is a counterfactual bid-price diagnostic, not an executable trade result.

limitations: This previously uninspected history precedes development chronologically. It is external historical confirmation, not forward testing or a chronological post-training holdout.
Provider prices can differ from the user broker. These results are never labeled MT5 account history or realized account profits.
Input spread proxies, the $0.37 constant and slippage/fees are assumptions unless explicit native bid/ask candles establish the relevant fields.
Complete M5 buckets omit partial minutes. Native provider candles may not equal these aggregates; missing periods and insufficient warmup are disclosed.
Closed-session M1 records are removed from BOTH indicators and execution. Sunday or maintenance indicative quotes cannot trigger stops/targets; holiday/early-close status remains unverified.
One position, no same-minute reentry after an existing position closes, exact next-minute entries and live 0.1R pre-fill bracket/drift checks apply.
Both-hit minutes resolve stop first. Gap stops use adverse opening quotes and target gaps receive no favorable improvement; exact hit seconds remain unknown.
Unobserved intervals may conceal executions. Gap-crossing trades are conditional; contiguous-path metrics are a subset, not a separately simulated account.
Open positions are censored. Closed-trade drawdown excludes floating loss. No swaps, news gating, lot rounding, margin, funding or account-currency sizing are modeled.
No candidate parameters, dates, targets or preferred direction are retuned from these results. Conflicting or small samples cannot certify a profitable edge.

Rounded absolute plans use the separately audited actual PHP evaluator. Independent entry times, directions, raw RSI/ATR and trend/session decisions agree; documented four-decimal ties are not strategy changes.

numerical_replay_comparison.note: Only PHP-compatible four-decimal plan values changed; all model parameters and the independent M1 replay are unchanged.
